name: Tiflucarbine
summary: Tiflucarbine (BAY-P 4495 or TVX P 4495) is an experimental drug which acts as an agonist of the 5-HT1 and 5-HT2 serotonin receptor families, and also acts as a calmodulin inhibitor. It has antidepressant effects in animal studies. It produces the head-twitch response, a behavioral proxy of psychedelic effects, in rodents.
